{{Quote|Oh, great. More people wanting to talk. Just like those Gungans that came by not long ago. The Muskeg, I think they called themselves. Came by asking about my son Hunnos just before he escaped.|[[Ados Jarkey]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FaEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find an Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref>}}
'''Dubbin Sharr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Muskegs|Muskeg]] zealot [[Chief/Legends|chief]] who operated outside of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CaEM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Dubbin Sharr tried to recruit the wanted murderer [[Hunnos Jarkey]] to assassinate members of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo human government]] but the latter refused. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sundria Khartoor|Khartoor]] of the [[Royal Security Police Force|Violent Crimes Division]] later tasked [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] agents to investigate Dubbin Sharr's group of Muskegs fanatics. Sharr was killed during the raid.<ref name="SWG:CaEM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dubbin Sharr appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CaEM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dubbin Sharr was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
